parameters.question: Compare Welch's t-test and Cohen's d results (Alzheimer's vs controls, n=50 each). The mean difference and Cohen's d must match within 1% relative error. The p-value must match within +/-0.001. The bootstrap 95% CI bounds (10,000 iterations, seed 42) must match within +/-0.05. The effect size label (Small/Medium/Large) must match exactly. Column order and header labels may differ.
